topics._comment: Beat-3 opening: greeting + Lupa lore + name-elicit. Gated on lupa_felled (post-fight) and !name_given (Vagrant has no name yet). Fires once; on completion the Guide opens the name-prompt modal. The name-prompt's commit (NamePromptScreen::commit) chains DIRECTLY into the class picker -- naming + class-pick are ONE character-creation sequence, no re-engagement of the Guide between them. There is no separate 'offer-Signing' dialog beat; the picker's own header text IS the Signing-offer framing. After the picker commits, ClassPickerScreen calls SaveManager::finalizeUnnamedCharacter and post_signing_first_words becomes the next eligible topic when the player re-engages the Guide.

topics._comment: Guide-reveal topics, one per insight node from config/insight/world.json. Each topic is gated on (a) post_signing_first_words seen, AND (b) the world-side examine flag (examined:<subject>) set by selva::insight::notifyExamined. When the player enters the topic, it fires the Guide-named insight node via unlocks_insight -- which promotes the corresponding lang-map entries to tier-2. Topics ARE one-shot via the standard 'flags_forbidden: seen_topic_<id>' pattern (the dialog system tracks topic-seen automatically). Author the actual lines of the Guide-naming when ready; placeholder prose marked TODO so authoring bugs surface.
